Participant answers the question, mentioning induction.
Prof. Fontes guides the discussion towards the topic of ellipses.

scenes.contextualRelevance: This scene focuses on exploring the concept of ellipses and their mathematical properties. It implies a link between seemingly disparate phenomena.

mood.description: Curious: The scene starts with a challenging question, creating a sense of intrigue and prompting intellectual curiosity. As Prof. Fontes explains the ellipse-drawing method, the mood shifts towards clarity and understanding.

narrativeProgression.description: Prof. Fontes asks a challenging question about the nature of charges.
A participant attempts to answer the question, bringing up the concept of induction.
Prof. Fontes shifts the focus to ellipses, demonstrating a practical way to draw one.
Text overlay reveals that James Clerk Maxwell is said to have discovered this method at a young age.
Prof. Fontes delves into the mathematical definition of an ellipse, writing a formula on the whiteboard.

Vignan Prasar & IISER, Pune present Prof Pierre Fontes who through kitchen, toys and day to day materials deconstructs the aura of science for school teachers. 

Here is a short clip on drawing an ellipse.
